accepted_prior_and_missing_bridges: The base ProviderFailoverPolicy already continued after an empty result and returned the first nonempty result. Its tuple did not retain per-provider outcome records or a typed exhausted state; on total exhaustion it returned the last provider name, an empty hit list, and only the last error. The service could not distinguish all-empty, mixed error/unsuitable, and budget-stop outcomes in persisted query traces. Review also found that two 0.70s empty-provider calls could take 1.403s under a 1.0s run budget because the aggregate deadline did not enter fallback. The candidate preserves ordered policy, applies the remaining deadline to each provider request with cancellation, and persists a distinct max-wall stop. Source: policy-engine/src/polisyos/scholar/search/providers.py@198076863e143dea9f89f02734b13d50dae3eed5 and policy-engine/src/polisyos/scholar/search/service.py@198076863e143dea9f89f02734b13d50dae3eed5.

The base search page fetcher and seed URL fetcher had separate raw HTTP implementations. Existing URL/redirect admission remains owned by SearchConstraints and validate_fetch_url; the candidate wires both callers through one raw transport without changing that policy owner. Independent review found that CachedPageRecord.to_fetch_result bypassed current final-URL, MIME, and maximum-byte admission and trusted cached text without resolving raw bytes. The candidate reads the record's CAS snapshot, applies the same current payload-admission seam used by fresh transport, and refuses unavailable or marker-mismatched snapshots. Sources: policy-engine/src/polisyos/scholar/search/fetcher.py@198076863e143dea9f89f02734b13d50dae3eed5, policy-engine/src/polisyos/scholar/discover/transport.py@198076863e143dea9f89f02734b13d50dae3eed5, and policy-engine/src/polisyos/scholar/search/cache.py@198076863e143dea9f89f02734b13d50dae3eed5.

The base seed adapter already resolved and verified CAS bytes when the source had a raw reference, but it could substitute the mutable URL cache's current artifact ID when the source lacked one. The base decision-packet web-evidence projection read bundle metadata without resolving and verifying each source's raw CAS artifact. The candidate requires source-bound ref or digest, emits typed gaps without URL fallback, and makes the packet consumer read and verify per-source snapshots. Sources: policy-engine/src/polisyos/scholar/api.py@198076863e143dea9f89f02734b13d50dae3eed5 and policy-engine/src/polisyos/scientist/nodes/builtins/decide/decision_packet/enrichment.py@198076863e143dea9f89f02734b13d50dae3eed5.
